63: // BuildIPList builds list of ip addresses for the ports in binding file.
64: // (Both DUT and ATE ports).
65: func BuildIPList(t *testing.T) {
66: 	dut := ondatra.DUT(t, "dut")
67: 	var dutIPIndex, ipSubnet, ateIPIndex int = 1, 2, 2
68: 	var endSubnetIndex = 253
69: 	for _, dp := range dut.Ports() {
70: 		dutNextIP := nextIP(net.ParseIP(dutStartIPAddr), dutIPIndex, ipSubnet)
71: 		ateNextIP := nextIP(net.ParseIP(ateStartIPAddr), ateIPIndex, ipSubnet)
72: 		DUTIPList[dp.ID()] = dutNextIP
73: 		ATEIPList[dp.ID()] = ateNextIP
74: 
75: 		// Increment DUT and ATE host ip index by 4.
76: 		dutIPIndex = dutIPIndex + 4
77: 		ateIPIndex = ateIPIndex + 4
78: 
79: 		// Reset DUT and ATE IP indexes when it is greater than endSubnetIndex.
80: 		if dutIPIndex > int(endSubnetIndex) {
81: 			ipSubnet = ipSubnet + 1
82: 			dutIPIndex = 1
83: 			ateIPIndex = 2
84: 		}
85: 	}
86: 
87: }
88: 
89: // nextIP returns ip address based on hostIndex and subnetIndex provided.
90: func nextIP(ip net.IP, hostIndex int, subnetIndex int) net.IP {
91: 	s := ip.String()
92: 	sa := strings.Split(s, ".")
93: 	sa[2] = strconv.Itoa(subnetIndex)
94: 	sa[3] = strconv.Itoa(hostIndex)
95: 	s = strings.Join(sa, ".")
96: 	return net.ParseIP(s)
97: }

103: 
104: 	// Network instance and BGP configs.

110: 	global.RouterId = ygot.String(dutStartIPAddr)

113: 	afi.Enabled = ygot.Bool(true)
114: 
115: 	pg := bgp.GetOrCreatePeerGroup(PeerGrpName)
116: 	pg.PeerAs = ygot.Uint32(ATEAs)
117: 	pg.PeerGroupName = ygot.String(PeerGrpName)

138: 	isisLevel2.MetricStyle = oc.Isis_MetricStyle_WIDE_METRIC
139: 
140: 	isisLevel2Auth := isisLevel2.GetOrCreateAuthentication()
141: 	isisLevel2Auth.Enabled = ygot.Bool(true)
142: 	isisLevel2Auth.AuthPassword = ygot.String(authPassword)
143: 	isisLevel2Auth.AuthMode = oc.IsisTypes_AUTH_MODE_MD5
144: 	isisLevel2Auth.AuthType = oc.KeychainTypes_AUTH_TYPE_SIMPLE_KEY

147: 		// Interfaces config.

150: 		if *deviations.InterfaceEnabled {

159: 			s4.Enabled = ygot.Bool(true)
160: 		}
161: 		a4 := s4.GetOrCreateAddress(DUTIPList[dp.ID()].String())
162: 		a4.PrefixLength = ygot.Uint8(plenIPv4)

164: 		// BGP neighbor configs.

167: 		if dp.ID() == "port1" {

169: 		} else {
170: 			nv4.PeerAs = ygot.Uint32(ATEAs)
171: 		}
172: 		nv4.Enabled = ygot.Bool(true)

177: 		isisIntf.HelloPadding = oc.Isis_HelloPaddingType_ADAPTIVE
178: 		isisIntf.CircuitType = oc.Isis_CircuitType_POINT_TO_POINT

184: 		isisIntfAuth.AuthType = oc.KeychainTypes_AUTH_TYPE_SIMPLE_KEY

187: 		isisIntfLevel.Enabled = ygot.Bool(true)

203: // ConfigureATE configures ATE ports with IPv4, ISIS and BGP peers.
204: func ConfigureATE(t *testing.T, ate *ondatra.ATEDevice) {
205: 	topo := ate.Topology().New()
206: 
207: 	for _, dp := range ate.Ports() {
208: 		ISISMetricArray = append(ISISMetricArray, ISISMetric)
209: 		ISISSetBitArray = append(ISISSetBitArray, true)
210: 		atePortAttr := attrs.Attributes{
211: 			Name:    "ate" + dp.ID(),
212: 			IPv4:    ATEIPList[dp.ID()].String(),
213: 			IPv4Len: plenIPv4,
214: 		}
215: 		iDut1 := topo.AddInterface(dp.Name()).WithPort(dp)
216: 		iDut1.IPv4().WithAddress(atePortAttr.IPv4CIDR()).WithDefaultGateway(DUTIPList[dp.ID()].String())
217: 
218: 		// Add BGP routes and ISIS routes. ATE port1 is ingress port.
219: 		if dp.ID() == "port1" {
220: 			bgpDut1 := iDut1.BGP()
221: 			bgpDut1.AddPeer().WithPeerAddress(DUTIPList[dp.ID()].String()).WithLocalASN(ateAs2).
222: 				WithTypeExternal()
223: 
224: 			isisDut1 := iDut1.ISIS()
225: 			isisDut1.WithLevelL2().WithNetworkTypePointToPoint().WithTERouterID(DUTIPList[dp.ID()].String()).WithAuthMD5(authPassword)
226: 
227: 			netCIDR := fmt.Sprintf("%s/%d", advertiseBGPRoutesv4, 32)
228: 			bgpNeti1 := iDut1.AddNetwork("bgpNeti1")
229: 			bgpNeti1.IPv4().WithAddress(netCIDR).WithCount(RouteCount)
230: 			bgpNeti1.BGP().WithNextHopAddress(atePortAttr.IPv4)
231: 
232: 			netCIDR = fmt.Sprintf("%s/%d", advertiseISISRoutesv4, 32)
233: 			isisnet1 := iDut1.AddNetwork("isisnet1")
234: 			isisnet1.IPv4().WithAddress(netCIDR).WithCount(RouteCount)
235: 			isisnet1.ISIS().WithActive(true).WithIPReachabilityMetric(20)
236: 
237: 			continue
238: 		}
239: 
240: 		// Add BGP on ATE.
241: 		bgpDut1 := iDut1.BGP()
242: 		bgpDut1.AddPeer().WithPeerAddress(DUTIPList[dp.ID()].String()).WithLocalASN(ATEAs).
243: 			WithTypeExternal()
244: 
245: 		// Add ISIS on ATE.
246: 		isisDut1 := iDut1.ISIS()
247: 		isisDut1.WithLevelL2().WithNetworkTypePointToPoint().WithTERouterID(DUTIPList[dp.ID()].String()).WithAuthMD5(authPassword)
248: 
249: 	}
250: 
251: 	t.Log("Pushing config to ATE...")
252: 	topo.Push(t)
253: 	t.Log("Starting protocols on ATE...")
254: 	topo.StartProtocols(t)
255: }

257: // VerifyISISTelemetry verifies ISIS telemetry on DUT.
258: func VerifyISISTelemetry(t *testing.T, dut *ondatra.DUTDevice) {
259: 	statePath := gnmi.OC().NetworkInstance(*deviations.DefaultNetworkInstance).Protocol(oc.PolicyTypes_INSTALL_PROTOCOL_TYPE_ISIS, ISISInstance).Isis()
260: 	for _, dp := range dut.Ports() {
261: 		nbrPath := statePath.Interface(dp.Name())
262: 		query := nbrPath.LevelAny().AdjacencyAny().AdjacencyState().State()
263: 		_, ok := gnmi.WatchAll(t, dut, query, time.Minute, func(val *ygnmi.Value[oc.E_Isis_IsisInterfaceAdjState]) bool {
264: 			state, present := val.Val()
265: 			return present && state == oc.Isis_IsisInterfaceAdjState_UP
266: 		}).Await(t)
267: 		if !ok {
268: 			t.Logf("ISIS state on %v has no adjacencies", dp.Name())
269: 			t.Fatal("No ISIS adjacencies reported.")
270: 		}
271: 	}
272: }
273: 
274: // VerifyBgpTelemetry verifies BGP telemetry on DUT.
275: func VerifyBgpTelemetry(t *testing.T, dut *ondatra.DUTDevice) {
276: 	statePath := gnmi.OC().NetworkInstance(*deviations.DefaultNetworkInstance).Protocol(oc.PolicyTypes_INSTALL_PROTOCOL_TYPE_BGP, "BGP").Bgp()
277: 	for _, peerAddr := range ATEIPList {
278: 		nbrIP := peerAddr.String()
279: 		nbrPath := statePath.Neighbor(nbrIP)
280: 
281: 		// Get BGP neighbor state.
282: 		_, ok := gnmi.Watch(t, dut, nbrPath.SessionState().State(), time.Minute, func(val *ygnmi.Value[oc.E_Bgp_Neighbor_SessionState]) bool {
283: 			state, present := val.Val()
284: 			return present && state == oc.Bgp_Neighbor_SessionState_ESTABLISHED
285: 		}).Await(t)
286: 		if !ok {
287: 			t.Fatal("No BGP neighbor formed")
288: 		}
289: 		status := gnmi.Get(t, dut, nbrPath.SessionState().State())
290: 		if want := oc.Bgp_Neighbor_SessionState_ESTABLISHED; status != want {
291: 			t.Errorf("BGP peer %s status got %d, want %d", nbrIP, status, want)
292: 		}
293: 
294: 	}
295: }

183: 		isisIntfAuth.AuthMode = oc.IsisTypes_AUTH_MODE_MD5
184: 		isisIntfAuth.AuthType = oc.KeychainTypes_AUTH_TYPE_SIMPLE_KEY
185: 
186: 		isisIntfLevel := isisIntf.GetOrCreateLevel(2)
187: 		isisIntfLevel.Enabled = ygot.Bool(true)
188: 
189: 		isisIntfLevelTimers := isisIntfLevel.GetOrCreateTimers()
190: 		isisIntfLevelTimers.HelloInterval = ygot.Uint32(1)
191: 		isisIntfLevelTimers.HelloMultiplier = ygot.Uint8(5)
192: 
193: 		isisIntfLevelAfi := isisIntfLevel.GetOrCreateAf(oc.IsisTypes_AFI_TYPE_IPV4, oc.IsisTypes_SAFI_TYPE_UNICAST)
194: 		isisIntfLevelAfi.Metric = ygot.Uint32(200)
195: 		isisIntfLevelAfi.Enabled = ygot.Bool(true)
196: 	}
197: 	p := gnmi.OC()
198: 	fptest.LogQuery(t, "DUT", p.Config(), d)
199: 
200: 	return d
201: }

203: // ConfigureATE configures ATE ports with IPv4, ISIS and BGP peers.
204: func ConfigureATE(t *testing.T, ate *ondatra.ATEDevice) {
205: 	topo := ate.Topology().New()
206: 
207: 	for _, dp := range ate.Ports() {
208: 		isisMetricArray = append(isisMetricArray, isisMetric)
209: 		isisSetBitArray = append(isisSetBitArray, true)
210: 		atePortAttr := attrs.Attributes{
211: 			Name:    "ate" + dp.ID(),
212: 			IPv4:    ateIPList[dp.ID()].String(),
213: 			IPv4Len: plenIPv4,
214: 		}
215: 		iDut1 := topo.AddInterface(dp.Name()).WithPort(dp)
216: 		iDut1.IPv4().WithAddress(atePortAttr.IPv4CIDR()).WithDefaultGateway(dutIPList[dp.ID()].String())
217: 
218: 		// Add BGP routes and ISIS routes. ATE port1 is ingress port.
219: 		if dp.ID() == "port1" {
220: 			bgpDut1 := iDut1.BGP()
221: 			bgpDut1.AddPeer().WithPeerAddress(dutIPList[dp.ID()].String()).WithLocalASN(ateAS2).
222: 				WithTypeExternal()
223: 
224: 			isisDut1 := iDut1.ISIS()
225: 			isisDut1.WithLevelL2().WithNetworkTypePointToPoint().WithTERouterID(dutIPList[dp.ID()].String()).WithAuthMD5(authPassword)
226: 
227: 			netCIDR := fmt.Sprintf("%s/%d", advertiseBGPRoutesv4, 32)
228: 			bgpNeti1 := iDut1.AddNetwork("bgpNeti1")
229: 			bgpNeti1.IPv4().WithAddress(netCIDR).WithCount(routeCount)
230: 			bgpNeti1.BGP().WithNextHopAddress(atePortAttr.IPv4)
231: 
232: 			netCIDR = fmt.Sprintf("%s/%d", advertiseISISRoutesv4, 32)
233: 			isisnet1 := iDut1.AddNetwork("isisnet1")
234: 			isisnet1.IPv4().WithAddress(netCIDR).WithCount(routeCount)
235: 			isisnet1.ISIS().WithActive(true).WithIPReachabilityMetric(20)
236: 
237: 			continue
238: 		}
239: 
240: 		// Add BGP on ATE.
241: 		bgpDut1 := iDut1.BGP()
242: 		bgpDut1.AddPeer().WithPeerAddress(dutIPList[dp.ID()].String()).WithLocalASN(ateAS).
243: 			WithTypeExternal()
244: 
245: 		// Add ISIS on ATE.
246: 		isisDut1 := iDut1.ISIS()
247: 		isisDut1.WithLevelL2().WithNetworkTypePointToPoint().WithTERouterID(dutIPList[dp.ID()].String()).WithAuthMD5(authPassword)
248: 
249: 	}
250: 
251: 	t.Log("Pushing config to ATE...")
252: 	topo.Push(t)
253: 	t.Log("Starting protocols on ATE...")
254: 	topo.StartProtocols(t)
255: }

257: // VerifyISISTelemetry verifies ISIS telemetry on DUT.
258: func VerifyISISTelemetry(t *testing.T, dut *ondatra.DUTDevice) {
259: 	statePath := gnmi.OC().NetworkInstance(*deviations.DefaultNetworkInstance).Protocol(oc.PolicyTypes_INSTALL_PROTOCOL_TYPE_ISIS, isisInstance).Isis()
260: 	for _, dp := range dut.Ports() {
261: 		nbrPath := statePath.Interface(dp.Name())
262: 		query := nbrPath.LevelAny().AdjacencyAny().AdjacencyState().State()
263: 		_, ok := gnmi.WatchAll(t, dut, query, time.Minute, func(val *ygnmi.Value[oc.E_Isis_IsisInterfaceAdjState]) bool {
264: 			state, present := val.Val()
265: 			return present && state == oc.Isis_IsisInterfaceAdjState_UP
266: 		}).Await(t)
267: 		if !ok {
268: 			t.Logf("ISIS state on %v has no adjacencies", dp.Name())
269: 			t.Fatal("No ISIS adjacencies reported.")
270: 		}
271: 	}
272: }

274: // VerifyBgpTelemetry verifies BGP telemetry on DUT.
275: func VerifyBgpTelemetry(t *testing.T, dut *ondatra.DUTDevice) {
276: 	statePath := gnmi.OC().NetworkInstance(*deviations.DefaultNetworkInstance).Protocol(oc.PolicyTypes_INSTALL_PROTOCOL_TYPE_BGP, "BGP").Bgp()
277: 	for _, peerAddr := range ateIPList {
278: 		nbrIP := peerAddr.String()
279: 		nbrPath := statePath.Neighbor(nbrIP)
280: 
281: 		// Get BGP neighbor state.
282: 		_, ok := gnmi.Watch(t, dut, nbrPath.SessionState().State(), time.Minute, func(val *ygnmi.Value[oc.E_Bgp_Neighbor_SessionState]) bool {
283: 			state, present := val.Val()
284: 			return present && state == oc.Bgp_Neighbor_SessionState_ESTABLISHED
285: 		}).Await(t)
286: 		if !ok {
287: 			t.Fatal("No BGP neighbor formed")
288: 		}
289: 		status := gnmi.Get(t, dut, nbrPath.SessionState().State())
290: 		if want := oc.Bgp_Neighbor_SessionState_ESTABLISHED; status != want {
291: 			t.Errorf("BGP peer %s status got %d, want %d", nbrIP, status, want)
292: 		}
293: 
294: 	}
295: }
